title: AAR publishes 2026 Sustainability Report
body_markdown:
**Wood Dale, Illinois** — AAR CORP., the leading parts, repair, and software platform in the aviation aftermarket, today published its 2026 Sustainability Report, presenting key achievements and continued progress across the Company’s environmental, social, and governance efforts.


The 2026 Sustainability Report details AAR’s sustainability initiatives and achievements over the last year, including investments in renewable energy and environmental management, continued advancement of workplace safety and team member engagement, and strengthened compliance and supply chain oversight. The Report also describes AAR’s approach to sustainability governance and its focus on creating long-term value for its stakeholders.


Highlights from AAR’s 2026 Sustainability Report include:


- **Expanding environmental initiatives:** AAR completed the installation of 7,770 solar panels at its Airframe MRO facility in Greensboro, North Carolina.
- **Strengthening environmental management:** AAR expanded its ISO 14001 certifications, an internationally recognized standard for environmental management systems, to include its Component MRO facility in Grand Prairie, Texas.
- **Reinforcing AAR’s safety culture:** AAR team members identified physical safety as the Company’s strongest attribute for the second consecutive year in the Company’s annual engagement survey. The Company also received Canadian Occupational Safety’s 2026 5-Star Safety Cultures Award.
- **Supporting communities and aviation workforce development:** AAR continued investing in education, workforce development, and community outreach, including by hosting Oklahoma Women in Aviation and Aerospace Day to introduce attendees to career opportunities in aviation.
- **Strengthening governance and supply chain oversight:** AAR enhanced expectations in its Supplier Code of Conduct and established a cross-functional Artificial Intelligence Governance Committee.


“AAR’s 2026 Sustainability Report reflects the progress we are making to strengthen our environmental, social, and governance initiatives,” said Jessica Garascia, AAR’s Senior Vice President, General Counsel, Chief Administrative Officer, and Secretary. “As we grow, we remain focused on operating responsibly and advancing practices that support the long-term strength of our Company and the communities in which we operate.”


AAR’s 2026 Sustainability Report is available on the Sustainability page of its website at[https://www.aarcorp.com/en/about/sustainability/](https://www.aarcorp.com/en/about/sustainability/) .


**About AAR**
AAR is a leading global aerospace and defense aftermarket solutions company with operations in over 20 countries. Headquartered in the Chicago area, AAR supports commercial and government customers through three primary operating segments: Parts Supply; Repair, Engineering, and Software; and Government Solutions. Additional information can be found at[aarcorp.com](https://www.aarcorp.com/en/) .
